text: Good. These are good storage bins. I like them, but I have some issues with them. First, they aren't the correct size to hold one normal box of cereal. Second, the lid can be a little difficult to get on and off properly. It just wants to be wonky. it did come with label stickers. Also, they don't fit stacked on my shelves. I know that is a personal pantry issue, but it is the reason they just aren't the best solution for me. I like them. They're pretty good. But they have issues.
